users.subtitle: Accounts, roles and access. Changes are written to the audit log.
users.caption: Users, with AI usage for {{month}}
users.selectAll: Select every user on this page
users.deletedWarning: User deleted, but some of their files could not be removed from storage.

confirm.disable: They cannot sign in again until enabled, and the admin pages refuse them at once. A session already open keeps working for up to 15 minutes. You are never included.
confirm.role_admin: They get full admin access. Only active, verified accounts can be promoted; if one cannot, nothing changes.
confirm.role_user: They lose the admin pages at once; other admin-level access ends within 15 minutes. The last remaining admin cannot be demoted; if that would happen, nothing changes.

userDetail.title: User
userDetail.promoteHint: Only an active, verified account can become an admin.
userDetail.selfHint: You cannot change your own role or status, or delete yourself.

done.promote: The user is now an admin. It applies at their next sign-in refresh (within 15 minutes).
done.demote: The user is no longer an admin. Admin pages stop working for them at once.
done.disable: The user is disabled and signed out everywhere.
done.enable: The user can sign in again.
done.reset: A password reset link was emailed.
done.resetNoMail: The reset link could not be emailed: mail is not set up on the server.

promote.title: Make this user an admin?
promote.body: {{name}} will get full admin access, including every meeting and every setting.

demote.title: Remove admin access?
demote.body: {{name}} will become a normal user. The admin pages refuse them at once; other admin-level access ends within 15 minutes.

disable.title: Disable this account?
disable.body: {{name}} cannot sign in again until you enable the account. A session already open keeps working for up to 15 minutes.

reset.title: Send a password reset?
reset.body: {{name}} receives an email with a link to choose a new password. Their current password keeps working until then.

delete.title: Delete this user permanently?
delete.body: {{name}} and everything they own are deleted: meetings, recordings, transcripts, folders and chats. This cannot be undone.

errors.empty: Enter minutes or questions to add.
errors.whole: Chat questions must be a whole number.
errors.tooLarge: That is more than one grant allows (100,000 minutes, 1,000,000 questions).
errors.grouping: Type the number without thousands separators (for example 1000).

quota.confirmBody: Add {{minutes}} audio minutes and {{queries}} questions to {{name}}? This cannot be undone here.

health.subtitle: Checks of the database, file storage, keys and worker tasks.

pipeline.confirmBody_other: Each is processed again from the start, and each owner is charged audio minutes again. Current transcripts and notes stay until the new runs replace them.
pipeline.requeuePartial: {{count}} queued again; {{failed}} refused (already running, or the audio is missing): {{titles}}.

usage.chartSummary: {{days}} days with usage, highest day {{max}}. The table below has every value.

audit.subtitle: Every change made by an admin, newest first.

keys.subtitle: Provider API keys. A saved key can never be viewed again; only its label and last 4 characters are shown.
keys.neverChecked: Keys have not been checked yet
keys.checked: Health check done: {{healthy}} healthy, {{unhealthy}} failing, {{unknown}} unknown.
keys.noKeys: No stored key. The server setting is used if one is set.

disable.title: Disable this key?
disable.body: {{label}} (••••{{last4}}) stops being used at once. Disabling does not revoke it: revoke a leaked key at the provider. The last active key of a provider cannot be disabled.

enable.title: Enable this key?
enable.body: {{label}} (••••{{last4}}) is used again for new requests.

delete.title: Delete this key?
delete.body: {{label}} (••••{{last4}}) is removed for good. The last active key of a provider cannot be deleted.

keys.label: Label
keys.saved: Key saved. It cannot be viewed again.

errors.label: Enter a label.
errors.labelLong: Use at most 80 characters for the label.

errors.keyLong: The key is too long (at most 512 characters).
errors.keyChars: The key cannot contain spaces or special characters.
errors.lastActive: This is the last active key of its provider. Add another key first.
errors.noSecret: The server cannot store keys: KEY_ENCRYPTION_SECRET is not set.

keys.secureBody: Keys are encrypted at rest and never sent back to the browser.

config.subtitle: Workspace settings. Each change asks first and is written to the audit log.
config.title: Settings

retention.name: Audio retention (days)
retention.help: Original recordings older than this are deleted by the worker once a day. Transcripts, notes and chats stay. Empty = keep forever.

hack.name: Seek fix for browser recordings
hack.help: Lets the player seek in recordings made in the browser, by downloading the whole file first.

config.retentionWarning: On its next run the worker permanently deletes the audio of every meeting older than {{days}} days. This cannot be undone.

errors.retention: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 3650, or leave it empty.

models.title: AI models
models.help: Existing meetings keep the model they were processed with.

errors.default: The system default must be one of the allowed models.
